entry.title: Before you enter

points.here: Only people who are here with you can see you in Match.
points.erased: Everything in Match is erased when you leave the venue, unless you both follow each other.
points.screenshots: Screenshots exist: others can capture what you share.
points.help: You can ask the venue for discreet help at any time.

entry.gamesGlobalHint: Turn this off to disappear from every game in every venue.
entry.gameSwitchHint: Appear in {{game}} while you are here.

public.title: Meet in public first
public.body: Talk in the venue's chat and meet where there are other people. Tell a friend where you are.

share.title: Share little
share.body: Don't share your address, workplace, financial details or codes. Nobody here needs them.

pressure.title: You can say no
pressure.body: Pass, ignore or block anyone who pressures you. You never owe anyone a reply.

report.title: Report and block
report.body: Use the ⋯ menu on any profile to report or block. Reports reach the venue and the JChat team.

help.title: Ask the venue for help
help.body: From the ⋯ menu you can alert the staff discreetly. Nobody else will see it.

presence.verifying: Checking that you're at the venue…
presence.verifyingHint: This takes a few minutes. Scanning the venue's QR activates Match right away.
presence.error: Couldn't verify your presence. We'll try again shortly.

denied.unavailable: Match isn't available for you at this venue.
denied.age_not_confirmed: Confirm your age in the app to use Match.
denied.games_disabled: Games are turned off in your settings.
denied.invalid_qr: That QR doesn't belong to this venue.
denied.location_required: Turn on location to verify you're at the venue.
denied.no_geofence: This venue can't verify presence yet.
denied.outside_radius: You seem to be outside the venue.
denied.impossible_travel: We couldn't verify your location. Try again in a few minutes.

scanner.title: Scan the venue's QR
scanner.hint: Point the camera at the QR code displayed in the venue.
scanner.permissionNeeded: Camera access is needed to scan the QR.
scanner.invalid: That doesn't look like a venue QR code.

leave.title: Leave {{business}}?
leave.body: Everything you did in Match here (likes, matches and chats) will be deleted. Followed people stay.
leave.error: Couldn't leave right now. Try again.

home.title: Match
home.placeholder: The deck arrives in the next update.

profile.title: My Match profile
profile.loadError: Couldn't load your profile. Try again.
profile.previewTitle: This is how others see you
profile.previewHint: Your card shows your first approved photo, your name and your interests. Your age is never shown.

photos.title: Photos
photos.hint: Up to {{max}} photos. Each one is reviewed before it appears.
photos.needApproved: You need at least one approved photo to appear in Match.
photos.limit: You already have the maximum number of photos.
photos.permission: Allow access in your settings to add photos.
photos.uploadError: Couldn't upload the photo. Try again.
photos.deleteError: Couldn't delete the photo. Try again.
photos.reorderError: Couldn't save the new order. Try again.
photos.deleteConfirmBody: It will be removed from your Match card.

interests.title: Interests
interests.empty: You have not picked any interests yet.

settings.title: Match settings
settings.ageHint: Only people in this range appear in your deck, and you appear in theirs. Ages are never shown.
settings.ageDefault: By default you see people close to your age (±1 year).
settings.newPeople: Tell me when new people arrive
settings.newPeopleHint: A generic notification when new people join Match at a venue where you have run out of cards.
settings.saveError: Couldn't save the setting. Try again.

interests.title: Your interests
interests.intro: Pick at least {{min}} things you like. They help show you people you have things in common with.
interests.loadError: Couldn't load the interests. Try again.
interests.saveError: Couldn't save your interests. Try again.

deck.endTitle: You've seen everyone at this venue
deck.endHint: Come back later: new people may arrive.
deck.notifyNewPeople: Tell me when new people arrive

errors.not_present: Match needs you to be at the venue.
errors.not_in_same_venue: That person is no longer at this venue.
errors.super_like_quota: You're out of Super Likes for today.

profileView.unavailable: This person is no longer available.

itsAMatch.title: It's a match!
itsAMatch.subtitle: You and {{name}} liked each other.
itsAMatch.followHint: If you follow each other, this chat stays after you leave the venue.

safety.blockBody: They will disappear from your deck, matches and chats, and you from theirs.

reasons.minor: I suspect they are a minor

safety.reportThanksBody: Your report reaches the venue and the JChat team.
safety.helpBody: We'll alert the venue staff without anyone else seeing it.
safety.helpSent: Done, we let the staff know
safety.helpSentBody: Someone from the venue will come to you. Stay where there are other people.
